description: Ministry of Land - Appointed Acquiring Officers for Dedduwa Trousim Development Project Mr. M. H. M. Dayarathne w.e.f. 01.04.2017 to 30.06.2017, Mr. P. S. Gunawardhana w.e.f. 01.05.2017 to 30.06.2017
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It appoints officers for land acquisitions related to the Dedduwa Tourism Development Project, which falls under land and property-related matters. While it mentions government appointments, the primary focus is on land acquisition procedures rather than government personnel changes or structural modifications. This fits the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) which includes "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" and "land development projects."
